title: The error-report scrub compiles a 51k-character pattern on first use (about a third of a second), on the browser's main thread
evidence: Closed 2026-11-26: measured that day, the pattern compiles on its first run (about 0.3 s), which already happens only on a page that sends a report. Warming it at idle would move that cost to every page view. PR 2125 closed. (H401)
